english.note: Use this more formal alternative for an additional negative clause or for the later items in a neither...nor series.

examples.english: This plan involves no private data, nor will it disclose any records.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃唔涉及私人資料，亦都唔會公開任何紀錄。
